parsed.post: The latest attempt with higher learning rate/capacity regressed (1.0625 vs 1.0609). Reverting to 892758a. It seems the model is sensitive to aggressive updates at this depth. I will now try introducing a small weight decay to improve generalization and stability.
parsed.description: Introduce a small weight decay (0.01) to the current best configuration (892758a) to help regularize the deeper model and prevent overfitting/instability.
